name: WARNING: In-Flight Red Wine Miniature Bottle (High Tannins, Histamines & Dehydration)
whyItWorks: Red wine is rich in astringent grape tannins and histamines that provoke mucosal mast cell degranulation. Combined with cabin dehydration, alcohol weakens gut barrier integrity, triggering nocturnal diarrhea upon arrival.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Decline alcoholic beverages on flights. Drink pure bottled spring water or coconut water.
